title: Great mattress protector!
text: Great mattress protector!. This is a really nice queen mattress protector. I have larger/deeper mattresses and had no trouble with this fitting my bed. Fits snugly and is water proof to help protect the mattress and it is super soft to the touch. The beige colors blends with my sheets well. No complaints, very happy with the quality.

product_metadata.title: Q Quard Mattress Protector Queen Size 100% Waterproof Dust Proof Fitted 18" Deep Pocket Bed Mattress Cover Breathable & Ultra Soft Washable for Comfort and Protection Terry Cotton, Beige

Comes in 6 sizes including Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King, California King constructed from high-quality Terry Fabric (80% Cotton 20% Polyester), our mattress encasement is designed to extend the life of your mattress.

[100% WATERPROOF& BREATHABLE] : Our advanced breathable membrane is completely waterproof and breathable allowing for air circulation while repelling obnoxious leaks and spills from everyday liquids. [REDEFINE YOUR SLEEP]: Enjoy the deepest and healthiest sleep with the breathable mattress protector.
